description: This file contains test cases for the DirectoryCache class and the buildDirectoryCacheKey function, written using the Vitest testing framework. It tests caching behavior, expiration, eviction, and clearing of cache entries.

classes.name: DirectoryCache
classes.description: A cache class with TTL expiration and LRU eviction policies for directory entries.

methods.name: buildDirectoryCacheKey
methods.description: Constructs cache key strings from input parameters, including fallbacks for missing account and signature.

methods.name: DirectoryCache.set
methods.description: Adds an entry to the cache with a specific key and associated config object.

methods.name: DirectoryCache.get
methods.description: Retrieves an entry from the cache if it exists and hasn't expired.

methods.name: DirectoryCache.clearMatching
methods.description: Removes cache entries whose keys match a certain predicate.

methods.name: DirectoryCache.clear
methods.description: Clears all cache entries associated with a specific configuration object.
